articles.summary: NEW YORK, Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Galloway Capital Partners, LLC announced that Galloway Capital, LP and its affiliates, Schedule 13D filers in PodcastOne, Inc. (NASDAQ: PODC), strongly support the Company’s decision to form a Special Committee of the Board of Directors to retain a financial advisor to evaluate strategic alternatives to maximize shareholder value. Galloway believes PodcastOne’s public market valuation substantially understates the value of its content portfolio, advertising relationships and distribution capabilities, particularly to a strategic acquirer. The Company was recently ranked 6th among participating U.S. podcast publishers and networks measured by Podtrac, reaching approximately 5.8 million unique U.S. listeners. “PodcastOne has expanded its revenue, programming and audience, yet we believe those achievements remain inadequately reflected in its share price,” said Bruce Galloway, Chief Executive Officer of Galloway Capital Partners. articles.title: Galloway Capital Supports the PodcastOne Board’s Decision to Retain a Financial Advisor to Explore Strategic Alternatives
